newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.description: Stay updated with the latest news from Stichting Boerengroep and friends news.

signup.title: Stay informed
signup.description: Our newsletter brings news about farming, food and what we organise. About once a month.
signup.consent_statement: By signing up, you consent to receive our newsletter and agree to our <privacyPolicy>privacy policy</privacyPolicy>.
signup.success_message: Thank you for subscribing! Please check your email to verify your subscription.
signup.error_message: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
signup.thanks_message: We sent you an email. Click the link in it to confirm, and you are on the list.
signup.already_title: You are already on the list
signup.already_message: This address already gets our newsletter. There is nothing more to do.
signup.invalid_email: That does not look like an email address. Check it and try again.

verify.title: Confirm your email address
verify.description: One click and you get our newsletter.
verify.no_token: This page needs the link from the confirmation email. Open that email and click the link in it.
verify.error_message: We could not confirm your address just now. Try the link again in a few minutes.
verify.confirmed_message: Thanks for confirming. The next newsletter comes to your inbox.
verify.invalid_title: This link does not work any more
verify.invalid_message: It may have been used already, in which case you are on the list. If you are not sure, sign up again and we send you a new link.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from Newsletter
unsubscribe.description: We're sorry to see you go. Please let us know why you're unsubscribing.
unsubscribe.no_token: No unsubscribe token provided. Please use the link from your email.
unsubscribe.reason_placeholder: e.g., Too many emails, Not relevant, etc.
unsubscribe.feedback_placeholder: Help us improve by sharing your thoughts...
unsubscribe.success_message: Thank you for being part of our community. You can always re-subscribe later if you change your mind.
unsubscribe.error_message: Failed to unsubscribe. Please try again or contact support.

exportData.title: Export Your Data
exportData.description: Request a copy of all personal data we have stored about you.
exportData.what_included: What's included in your data export:
exportData.gdpr_notice: This data export is provided in compliance with GDPR Article 15 (Right of Access).
exportData.delivery_notice: Your data export will be sent to your email address within 24 hours.
exportData.error_message: Failed to request data export. Please try again or contact support.

deleteData.title: Delete your data
deleteData.description: Remove your email address and everything we keep with it from our newsletter list.
deleteData.warning_message: Deleting cannot be undone. To get the newsletter again you would have to sign up again.
deleteData.deleted_communications: Your details at our mailing service
deleteData.reason_placeholder: If you like, tell us why.
deleteData.confirmation_text: I understand that this cannot be undone
deleteData.gdpr_notice: You have this right under Article 17 of the GDPR, the right to erasure.
deleteData.error_message: That did not work. Try again, or write to us and we do it for you.
deleteData.check_email_message: If this address is on our list, we just sent it an email. Click the link in that email to delete your data. This way nobody else can do it for you.
deleteData.confirm_description: This removes your email address and everything we keep with it, here and at our mailing service.
deleteData.success_message: Your email address and everything we kept with it are gone, here and at our mailing service.
deleteData.invalid_link: This link does not work any more. Your data may have been deleted already.
